answer: Bind each agent identity to one gym membership. First the gym checks the member's photo ID and signs a binding linking membership number to agent key. Second the member must check in at least four times a month, each visit logged by a scan of their copper membership card. Third, random audits re-confirm the membership is still active. Faking 1,000 agents means 1,000 memberships at $30 a month plus 4,000 staged check-ins a month, $30,000 a month burned. The kernel of trust is the front desk, and identities grow on it like a trellis, one vine per member, no second shoot from the same root.
